rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something strange, unusual, or unexpected.

example.english: This arrangement is really odd; I didn't expect it at all.
example.traditional: 呢個安排真係好奇怪，完全估唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 jyun4 cyun4 gu2 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this mathematical term for an odd number, and before a noun for things such as odd-numbered pages.

example.english: For this workbook, do the pages with odd numbers.
example.traditional: 呢本練習簿要做有奇數嘅頁。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 lin6 zaap6 bou2 jiu3 zou6 jau5 gei1 sou3 ge3 jip6

rows.note: Use this when a person or object has no partner, especially when it is the one left over after pairing or grouping.

example.english: I was the odd one out when we made groups.
example.traditional: 分組嗰陣得我一個落單。
example.jyutping: fan1 zou2 go2 zan6 dak1 ngo5 jat1 go3 lok6 daan1
